name: [🔥] Kick a Brainrot
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Kick a Brainrot!

👍 Like the game and join the group
👀 Join the discord for exclusive codes and in-game rewards!

How to Play:
🥚 Find Brainrots by hatching eggs
🌟 Discover Mythic and common eggs
🦶 Kick your Brainrots to trigger mutations
💥 Evolve through multiple stages
🧠 Collect more than 100 unique Brainrots!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players
